seo.metaDescription: How HariLeaf collects, uses and protects your personal data when you shop with us or use our platform, and how to exercise your rights under India’s DPDP Act.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.subtitle: How we handle your data on harileaf.org — including orders from our shop — and across the HariLeaf platform.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.body: We collect information you provide directly — such as your name, email address, organisation name, and any details submitted through our contact or demo request forms. When you use our platform, we automatically collect technical data including IP addresses, browser type, pages visited, and device identifiers. For farm operators using HariLeaf's field intelligence tools, we may collect operational telemetry such as sensor readings, crop metadata, and field boundaries, solely to deliver and improve the service.

sections.title: When You Shop With Us
sections.body: To take and deliver an order we collect your name, email address, mobile number and delivery address, and — only if you ask for a GST invoice in a business name — your GSTIN, business name and billing address. We use these details to process and deliver your order, issue the GST invoice or credit note the law requires, send you emails about that order (confirmation, shipping, delivery, cancellation, refund), handle returns and complaints, and prevent fraud (for example, asking you to confirm a cash-on-delivery order). If you use a discount code that is limited to one use per mobile number, we record your mobile number against that code to enforce the limit; it is removed together with your order details under the retention rules below. We do not create accounts or passwords; your order page is protected by a private link sent to your email. We send marketing emails only if you tick the box at checkout; you can withdraw that consent at any time by writing to privacy@harileaf.org or our customer care, and we will stop within 7 days.

sections.title: Payments
sections.body: Online payments are processed by Razorpay Software Private Limited. Your card, UPI or bank details are entered on Razorpay’s secure page and are never seen or stored by HariLeaf; we keep only the payment reference, amount and status. Cash-on-delivery amounts are collected by our courier partners. For a refund of a cash-on-delivery order we ask for a UPI ID or bank account, used only to send that refund.

sections.title: Who We Share Data With
sections.body: We share only what each service needs: Cloudflare (website hosting, database and security), Razorpay (online payments and refunds), Shiprocket and its courier partners (your name, email, phone and delivery address — and billing address if different — to deliver the parcel and collect cash on delivery), and Resend (to send order emails). Our pages load fonts from Google Fonts, so Google receives your IP address and browser details when you visit; our About page shows an Instagram feed through Behold. Some of these providers may process data outside India. Our processors are bound by contract to use your data only to provide their service to us. We do not sell your personal data. We may disclose information when the law requires it, for example to tax authorities or in response to a lawful order. For the HariLeaf platform we also use cloud infrastructure, analytics and communication providers on the same terms; a current list is available on request.

sections.title: How We Use It
sections.body: We use collected data to operate and improve the HariLeaf platform, respond to enquiries, send service-related communications, and personalise your experience. We may analyse aggregated, anonymised operational data to improve our AI models and produce industry insights. We do not sell your personal data to third parties. Marketing communications are opt-in only and you may unsubscribe at any time.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.body: Orders that became a sale — with an invoice, credit note or payment — are tax records: we keep them, with their invoices, for as long as Indian tax law requires (at least 72 months from the due date of the annual GST return for that year, CGST Act section 36), and review and delete records past that period at least once a year. Checkouts that were never paid, and orders cancelled before any payment, are anonymised automatically after 180 days. Marketing consent is kept until you withdraw it. Platform account data is retained for the duration of the relationship plus 36 months; contact and enquiry data for 24 months. Database backups are kept for up to 90 days.

sections.title: Your Rights
sections.body: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 you may ask us for a summary of the personal data we hold about you and how we use it, ask us to correct, complete or update it, ask us to erase it (we will, except where the law requires us to keep it, such as orders that are GST records — those we keep but stop using for anything else), withdraw any consent you have given, and nominate another person to exercise these rights on your behalf if you die or become unable to. To make a request, email privacy@harileaf.org from the address you used, with your order number if you have one. We will respond within 30 days. If you are not satisfied with our response, you may complain to the Data Protection Board of India.

sections.title: Grievance Officer
sections.body: You can raise any complaint about your data or an order with our Grievance Officer, whose name and contact details are published at harileaf.org/grievance. We acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and aim to resolve them within one month.

sections.title: Security and Breaches
sections.body: Our website uses HTTPS throughout, order pages are reachable only through private links (which you can replace at harileaf.org/order/find, retiring the old ones), store administration is restricted to authorised staff behind a sign-in, and payment details never reach our systems. If a personal data breach affects you, we will inform you and the Data Protection Board of India as the law requires, with what happened, the likely impact and what we are doing about it.

sections.title: Children
sections.body: Our shop is meant for adults. We do not knowingly collect personal data from anyone under 18; if you believe a child has placed an order or shared details with us, contact us and we will delete them.

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: For questions about this policy or to make a data request, email privacy@harileaf.org. Our registered name, postal address and Grievance Officer are listed at harileaf.org/grievance. We aim to respond to all privacy requests within 30 days.
